title: Atlas canonical effect
description: What a tool request does, independent of how it is spelled (SPEC §3.3.2). Produced by a deterministic normalizer before policy evaluation.

effect.description: exec: a program runs. exec.dynamic: code or a command name decided at runtime. fs.permission: mode or ownership change. device.write: raw block or character device. vcs.rewrite: history or working-tree changes the VCS can't undo.

target.description: Path, host or URL the effect applies to; null when not statically known.

scope.description: project: relative path. temp: /tmp, /var/tmp, /dev/null. home: ~, $HOME, /home, /root. system: other absolute paths. device: /dev/*. remote: URL or user@host:path.

reversible.description: Whether the effect can normally be undone.

command.description: Program producing the effect (basename), or the tool name for non-shell tools.
